items.title: Surface JSON/schema validation errors instead of silent help fallback
items.context: Root cause likely lives in CLI argument parsing / zod validation fallback: checklist_update with invalid nested verificationIntent enum prints only help, hiding invalid enum values. Expected behavior: command exits nonzero and prints actionable invalid path/value plus allowed enum values; empty object behavior should remain valid where schema allows it.

items.title: Whitelist Koala-generated init-self-check artifact for DONE cleanup
items.context: INIT_CHECK creates docs/story/actives/B-xxx/init-self-check.json, but DONE merge preflight treats the main-copy as non-whitelisted untracked data and blocks every full lifecycle. Expected behavior: Koala-generated init-self-check.json is recognized as safe story metadata during DONE cleanup without weakening protection for arbitrary user drafts.

items.title: Record dispatch audit events consumed by channel review
items.context: dispatch returns prompts for reviewer/item/finding work but does not append process-events dispatch evidence, while channel review expects dispatch evidence for normal/risk workflows. Expected behavior: successful dispatch writes an auditable process event with storyId, target kind/id, agentType, phase, and source without breaking read-only prompt retrieval semantics.
